messages:
paul: kicking off RC-2026.weekend for a planned Sunday midnight promotion. artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/rcs/rc-weekend-2026.tgz. requesting pin and change-window approval.

katie: change window approved (00:00-02:00 UTC Sun). will run a reduced-traffic canary and keep feature flag off by default.

deploy-bot: build rc-weekend-2026 (b-1600) uploaded :package:
artifact: s3://redwood-ci/rcs/rc-weekend-2026.tgz
sha256: c0ffee1234deadbeef5678cafebabe00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff00

paul: plan: pin -> staging deploy -> quick smoke -> canary 1% 30m (feature flag OFF) -> enable flag gradual 10% steps with monitoring. rollback plan: immediate flag revert + traffic rollback script.

katie: test note: release-notes mention a customer-visible opt-in toggle. product-omar please confirm wording; we shouldn't promise auto-on.

product-omar: confirmed, release notes updated to "opt-in via Settings -> Labs". no auto-on.

paul: creating pin now.

/deploy pin --create --artifact s3://redwood-ci/rcs/rc-weekend-2026.tgz --requested-by paul

deploy-bot: pin created -> pin-id: pin-rc-6499. status: PENDING_PROMOTE

katie: verifying artifact in staging. running `cictl verify --sha c0ffee...` and staging smoke.

sre-janet: quick reminder: reduced-nodepool during weekend reduces autoscaler headroom. monitor pod scheduling and node pressure.

katie: artifact verify passed. staging smoke 8/8 green. p95 latency within 3ms of baseline.

paul: promoting to canary with feature flag OFF. command:
```
/deploy promote --pin pin-rc-6499 --canary 1% --canary-duration 30m --tag rc-weekend-2026 --flag newsearch=false
```

deploy-bot: Promotion started. canary 1% -> routing configured. canary hosts: 2

[12m into canary]

sre-janet: noticing slightly elevated mem use on host canary-1 (model_worker). kube events show `BackOff` restart on model-preloader for 1 container. not yet OOM.

paul: hold on ramp. pausing further steps. canary traffic frozen at 1%.

oncall-sheriff: I'll take it. abort criteria: any OOM or error rate >0.5% sustained for 2m. currently error rate 0.2% - keep monitoring.

[3m later]

sre-janet: model-preloader crash loop due to transient disk I/O error on canary-1: `read: input/output error`. kernel logs show disk errors on /dev/nvme2.

paul: immediate plan: remove canary-1 from routing and reprovision a fresh host, keep canary at 1% on canary-2 only. also re-run `cictl node-health` on canary-1.

/deploy api remove-host --host canary-1 --reason 'disk io err'

deploy-bot: host removed from rotation. canary now running on 1 host (canary-2). routing adjusted.

katie: with canary on single host, traffic steady and error rate falls to baseline. newsearch flag still false.

paul: given infra issue, do we want to proceed with a larger canary? I'm inclined to stay conservative and keep flag off until prod nodepool remediation.

product-omar: agree. push this RC to 'staged' and schedule another attempt next weekend after infra patching. customers shouldn't see anything yet (flag OFF).

paul: marking RC as STAGED but not PROMOTED. updating release board and release notes to indicate postponement of enabling feature flag.

paul: before we close thread, adding note about rollback drills and the flag revert command for ops: `featurectl set newsearch false --env prod` — keep handy.

oncall-sheriff: closing thread; no rollback executed since traffic restored to stable behavior. track infra remediation in INC-2026-210 and reattempt promote after host replacement. :white_check_mark:
